observed: Four volatile-SRAM runs passed identically: FCB=0x000f0002, all eight error groups zero, all eight counter states observed, eight scratch patterns, final low-16 [+0,+4,+8,+c]=[0x004d,0,0,0]. The compiler-audited oracle covered reset-held write blocking; ID word/byte/halfword views; scratch word/halfword/independent-byte writes; counter range/coverage; foreign-write isolation; W1C clear, qualification set hook and set-wins; scratch preservation; and GPIO reset. Every run ended with board reset and no flash command.
controls: The hash-bound composer pins the exact +4 base, public8 donor and output. The independent checker proves all unmodified base cells exact, six reviewed overlay-cell changes, ten append-only base-route extensions, eighteen exact added BELs, unique placement/wire ownership, and byte-exact structural regeneration. Strict pack is pinned by pack_regression.json.
scope: One exact L48 HSE=8 SYSCLK=10 low-16 public map: ID 0x4d at +0, 16-bit scratch at +4, three-bit counter at +8 and one-bit W1C status at +c with a qualification-only bit1 set hook. It excludes HRDATA[31:16], canonical 32-bit ID 0x4147414d, bursts/full-window decode, misaligned/signed loads, arbitrary placement/width, other packages/profiles, a generic generator and a production status-set source.
consequence: The separately qualified +4 scratch and public ID/counter/W1C objects coexist in one deterministic, hash-pinned, SRAM-qualified low-16 map without weakening the retained scratch paths.
